name: gdelt-mcp-server
description: Search and analyze global news coverage and US TV transcripts via the GDELT Project APIs.

interface.shortDescription: Search and analyze global news coverage and US TV transcripts via the GDELT Project APIs.
interface.longDescription: Access the GDELT Project's real-time global news and TV transcript APIs. Search the last 3 months of news coverage in 65+ languages, retrieve coverage timelines and tone distributions, analyze geographic/language breakdowns (most of these modes also answer explicit windows older than 3 months), find GKG theme identifiers for theme: queries, and search historical TV news transcripts with coverage dates varying by station.
